num, den, max_iter = map(int, input().split())
ratio = num / den
if den <= 1:
    print(f"{num}/{den}")
else:
    numerator = 1
    denominator = 1
    min_difference = float('inf')
    epsilon = 1e-25
    for i in range(1, max_iter + 1):
        val = ratio * i
        a_floor = int(val // 1)
        a_ceil = a_floor + 1
        diff_floor = abs(ratio - a_floor / i)
        if diff_floor < min_difference - epsilon:
            min_difference = diff_floor
            numerator = a_floor
            denominator = i
        diff_ceil = abs(a_ceil / i - ratio)
        if diff_ceil < min_difference - epsilon:
            min_difference = diff_ceil
            numerator = a_ceil
            denominator = i
    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
